Info magang dari Hotel Borobudur Jakarta
Dear Future Leaders,
Hotel Borobudur Jakarta invites you to kickstart your career in the hospitality industry through our On the Job Training (OJT) Program for January – July 2027.
Take this valuable opportunity to gain firsthand experience in the dynamic world of hospitality, develop your professional skills, and build a strong professional network.
Please submit your updated CV to: traco@hotelborobudur.com
We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming the next generation of Future Leaders!

One of the finest luxury 5 star hotel in Jakarta, Indonesia,
strategically located in the center of the city. This property
features 23 acres of landscaped tropical gardens. The hotel
is a 5 minute drive from the Presidential Palace and is also
close to major sightseeing attractions such as Istiqlal
Mosque and Cathedral Church. It is within easy to reach of
government offices, major business and banking centers,
shopping and entertainment areas.
